name: Temporary Stay of Digital Nomads

requirements.blocker_text: Requires proof of average monthly income of at least EUR 3,622.50 (via bank statements or payslips), increased by 10% of the average monthly net salary for each additional accompanying family member or partner.
requirements.fix_path: Document qualifying monthly income (or the savings alternative) before applying.

requirements.blocker_text: Must work exclusively for employers or clients outside Croatia, or through one's own foreign-registered company; performing work or providing services to Croatia-based employers is not permitted.

evidence_required.document: Proof of remote employment/contract with a non-Croatian employer, or ownership of a foreign-registered company
Proof of financial means (income of EUR 3,622.50/month, or savings of EUR 43,470 for 12 months / EUR 65,205 for 18 months)
Proof of accommodation address in Croatia

outcome.duration_length: up to 18 months maximum (initial grant plus one extension of up to 6 months, requested within 60 days before expiry)

sources.title: Ministarstvo unutarnjih poslova Republike Hrvatske (mup.gov.hr) -- Temporary stay of digital nomads

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Croatia's initial build. Explicitly, this permit does NOT lead to permanent residence -- confirmed at tier-1, unlike some other countries' digital nomad routes in this dataset. A new application may only be submitted 6 months after a previous digital-nomad stay expires (a cooldown, not modelled as a separate field). Close family members (including common-law/life partners together 3+ years, or shorter with children) may join, but their applications submitted before the primary applicant's approval are rejected -- an ordering rule, not encoded as a hard requirement here. work_rights marked 'restricted' (schema enum) rather than 'none' since work itself is the entire basis of the permit, just restricted to non-Croatian employers/clients -- the specific restriction is spelled out in requirement hrdn_foreign_employer and this note, not in the enum value itself. study_rights set to 'none': the source does not describe any study entitlement attached to this permit.
